profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer on Google Drive
profile.summary: Senior software engineer at Google on Drive. Previously, I worked on infrastructure and personalization for YouTube. Currently I design and build features and infrastructure in the Drive backend. My primary development language is currently Java, and I have done professional development in C++ and Python in the past. I am an Eagle Scout.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior software engineer on Google Drive, building out the backend. Have experience doing migrations of backend systems on the fly, writing and deploying features used by millions of users every day, building testing and experimentation infrastructure and leading oncall rotations.
positions.insights: Skills: Core Java · Software Infrastructure · Software Design

positions.title: Guidance for Government Tech
positions.description:
-Helped the Department of Homeland Security evaluate prospective contractors to create a pool of high quality ones to choose from for future projects.
-Worked with Customs and Border Protection during the initial stages of their ground up rewrite of the Trusted Traveler Program's web application (ttp.cbp.dhs.gov). Wrote some of the initial code, and provided guidance on coding and design best practices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on YouTube personalization team, with a focus on obtaining and using various types of feedback to make users' YouTube experience better.

- Wrote a feedback service that handles many of the user interactions with the site (video and aggregate dismissals, channel interactions, subscriptions, radio interactions, survey responses, etc.).
- Wrote a full featured survey system that handles triggering, displaying, storing, and analyzing the majority of surveys shown across YouTube. Used by many teams across YouTube.
- Added follow up dismissal functionality to allow users to indicate why they removed content and to help filter that type of content moving forward.
- Worked to remove spammy, objectionable and racy content from the homepage.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked on Google Now, adding caching and UI enhancements to the search suggest feature before its Google I/O launch.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Intern at YouTube, wrote the HD video parser for the first iteration of the YouTube app on XBox. Also wrote an adaptive bit rate algorithm that seamlessly switched between different quality video streams automatically based on the user's current available bandwidth.

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description: Wrote a Windows startup process analyzer and disabler for Norton 360. Wrote SQL queries and created dashboards to track and visualize customer trends.

volunteerExperiences.description: I tutored people in the community who were trying to increase their English literacy.
Made quilts for the oncology unit of my local hospital for my Eagle Scout project.
